newsitem.title: USA: Farm wheel tractor sales off 5.1 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Farm wheel tractor sales off 5.1 pct in December.

text.p: Total farm wheel tractor sales declined 5.1 percent in December to 8,130 units from 8,567 a year ago but rose 6.7 percent for the full year, reported the Equipment Manufacturers Institute.
Full-year sales advanced to 115,298 units in 1996 from 108,043 in 1995, the trade group said.

For the year, total two-wheel drive tractor sales gained 6.9 percent to 110,860 units from 103,699, and total four-wheel drive tractor sales increased 2.2 percent to 4,438 units from 4,344. Self-propelled combine sales declined in the year by 1.8 percent to 9,026 units from 9,194 in 1995.
